policy.hypothesis: Within unchanged stage eligibility, prefer improving momentum, then higher median RS20 of same-sector classified peers, then the original surface rank.
policy.sectorMeasure: Median RS20 of classified peers in this snapshot; not a sector-index return. Missing sectors and fewer than three peers are unranked.
policy.momentumRule: momentumShift > 0; missing values rank after nonpositive values
policy.promotion: No automatic promotion. Review paired same-date excess returns, adverse excursions, missing outcomes and symbol/sector concentration after the review gate.
policy.limitations: Descriptive discovery selections, not trades. Repeated symbols, overlapping dates and sector effects are not independent observations.
